messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a spike in duplicate billing and reconnects tied to late ACKs on streaming responses this morning. telemetry shows a cluster of short-lived resume probes hitting quota counters.

maya: Ugh. Is this the probe that replays a small window when a resume token is missing?

chao: Yes. Edge proxies will send a probe if they think the client lost the connection. If the resume token arrives slightly later we end up double-counting tokens (one for failed attempt, one for resumed).

luis: Do we have any label in the metrics that says "probe" vs "user resume"?

infra-bot: deploy: infra/proxy 2026-03-20T08:10 UTC — v3.4.2 -> v3.4.3 (no rollback) :white_check_mark:

maya: Not reliably. We have stream_attempts and stream_resumes but probes are blended in. That's why Console shows quota drop without clear cause.

alex: Repro steps: create a long streaming chat, kill TCP for ~200ms, client reconnects and sends resume token ~150ms after, but proxy had already issued a probe and that probe consumed quota. Result: billing shows 2 partial windows charged.

chao: That timing window is nasty. Two ideas: (1) suppress probe quota charging if a resume token is received within probe_grace_ms (say 300ms), or (2) make probe request idempotent with a probe_id so we can dedupe billing if followed by resume.

luis: Option (1) seems easier to implement in routing logic. But we need a telemetry flag so billing can retroactively correct events for that grace window.

product-ux: If we change behavior, console UX should show "probing suppressed" state on the route events, otherwise customers will still open tickets.

maya: Also need to update rollout policy: enable suppression behind an experiment toggle and route to non-critical customers first. If we flip widely we might hide legitimate probe-induced errors.

chao: Implementation thoughts: add header X-Resume-Token-Timestamp to resumed requests and have proxy keep a tiny in-memory circular buffer of recently accepted tokens. If probe arrives and we later see a resume with matching session id within grace window, mark probe as suppressed and emit metric probe.suppressed=1.

alex: Concern: proxies are horizontally scaled. That shared buffer would be per-proxy, so resumes might land on different proxy instance. We need a deterministic routing (sticky) for short time or a small distributed cache. Both options have tradeoffs.

luis: Could we piggyback on existing sticky lease used for KV cache? Make sticky TTL = 500ms for streaming reconnects. That avoids distributed cache, small blast radius.

maya: Sticky changes affect routing heuristics and capacity. We should measure tail latency cost. I can run a loadtest with sticky TTL toggled.

product-ux: For Console telemetry, add a new metric series stream.probe_suppressed_count and surface a 'probe suppression' annotation in the timeline + link to affected traces.

chao: On billing line items: billing pipeline currently aggregates by request id and time window. We need to change invoice logic to prefer resumed token if a probe and resume are within same session window. Might require a second pass job to dedupe.

alex: Short term mitigation: reduce probe aggressiveness and increase probe_grace_ms to 400ms in config. Longer term: implement probe suppression + sticky routing + console telemetry + billing dedupe job.

luis: I'll spin up an experiment PR for proxy config (probe_grace_ms & probe_charging=false behind feature flag) and a Console annotation patch.

maya: I'll own the loadtest and telemetry dashboards to validate before rollout.

chao: I'll prototype probe id header and per-session suppression metric. Also will add trace span name "stream.probe" for visibility.

alex: Thanks. Assigning follow-ups: @luis PR, @maya loadtest + dashboard, @chao tracing + proto. We'll sync tomorrow 09:30. :thumbsup:

luis: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/452 (draft) — toggles probe charging behind flag.

maya: Loadtest results (dev cluster): probe suppression reduces duplicated charge events by ~93% with sticky TTL 500ms, p95 tail latency +2ms. Uploading graphs to shared drive.

chao: Prototype merged to internal branch, emitting probe.suppressed=1 and span. Need review from infra for rollout safety.

alex: Great. Please add a short one-liner in Console changelog and a note in billing runbook about the dedupe window so support can explain to customers.

product-ux: Will add UI note and quick tour to annotate "probing" vs "resumed" in per-route timeline.

infra-bot: job: billing/dedupe/2026-03-20 queued by luis — ETA 2h

alex: Closing loop: thanks everyone. We'll keep the feature flag off until we confirm no regression on multi-tenant tail.

maya: TL;DR — plan: temporary probe_grace config, experiment with sticky routing, add metrics + console UX, billing dedupe job.
